summary: 56 holdings; the top ten are 53% of the portfolio.
Trades a lot: about 62% of the portfolio changes in a year.
The average holding, by value, has been owned for 3.3 years.
Copying each filing beat the S&P 500 in 4 of 9 full years.

profile.background: Born in 1950; Washington and Lee University; served in the US Army. Ran the Legg Mason Value Trust, which beat the S&P 500 for 15 years in a row (1991–2005), then lost heavily in 2008. Left Legg Mason in 2016 and ran Miller Value Partners.
profile.approach: Value investing that also buys out-of-favour growth companies others think are too expensive.
known: An early and large investor in Amazon, and later in Bitcoin.
profile.note: Miller has retired from managing money day to day; Samantha McLemore runs Patient Capital, the successor business.

name: Bill Miller
